title: Curology Metric0 Monthly Rollup
dataSources: Curology prescriptions (`curology:prescription`), skin diaries (`skin:diary`), dermatology appointments (`derm:appointment`), and UV exposure logs (`uv:exposure`).
app: Curology prescription shipments, daily skin diary entries, dermatology appointment exports, and UV exposure tracker logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=curology:metric0
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count as events, sum(value) as total_value by _time
| sort _time
description: Summarises monthly event volume and total value for curology metric0 data.
value: Monthly rollups smooth daily noise and show seasonal shifts in personal activity.
implementation: Aggregate curology metric0 events monthly and chart count plus total value.
visualization: Column chart of monthly events with total value overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps how your curology metric0 activity added up each month instead of day by day.
